'''H1-2F''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
H1-2F appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Imperial vendor in the Quesh Warzone.
